        self.dimension = 384
        self.metadata = []
        self.doc_store = {}

            self.vector_index = faiss.read_index('faiss.index')

                self.doc_store = pickle.load(f)

            self.metadata = []
            self.doc_store = {}
        self.schema = Schema(url=ID(stored=True), content=TEXT(stored=True))
        if not os.path.exists('indexdir'):
            os.mkdir('indexdir')
        if exists_in('indexdir'):
            self.ix = open_dir('indexdir')
        else:
            self.ix = create_in('indexdir', self.schema)

        chunks = []
        start = 0
        while start < len(text):
            end = start + max_chunk_size
            chunk = text[start:end]
            chunks.append(chunk)
            start = end - overlap
            if start >= len(text):
                break
        return [c.strip() for c in chunks if c.strip()]

        try:
            resp = requests.get(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; SearchBot/1.0)'}, timeout=10)
            if resp.status_code != 200:
                return None
            soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, 'html.parser')
            meta = soup.find('meta', attrs={'name': 'robots'})
            if meta and 'noindex' in meta.get('content', '').lower():
                return None
            for s in soup(['script', 'style']):
                s.decompose()
            text = soup.get_text(separator=' ', strip=True)
            return text
        except:
            return None

    def add_to_index(self, url):
        text = self.crawl(url)
        if not text:
            return False
        self.doc_store[url] = text
        chunks = self.chunk_text(text)
        chunk_embs = []
        for chunk in chunks:
            emb = self.model.encode(chunk)
            chunk_embs.append(emb)
            self.metadata.append({'url': url, 'chunk': chunk})
        if chunk_embs:
            embs_array = np.array(chunk_embs).astype('float32')
            self.vector_index.add(embs_array)
        writer = self.ix.writer()
        writer.add_document(url=url, content=text)
        writer.commit()
        self.save()
        return True

        faiss.write_index(self.vector_index, 'faiss.index')
        with open('metadata.pkl', 'wb') as f:
            pickle.dump(self.metadata, f)
        with open('doc_store.pkl', 'wb') as f:
            pickle.dump(self.doc_store, f)

                results.append({'url': url, 'score': best_score, 'highlights': highlights, 'full_content': full})
            results.sort(key=lambda x: x['score'], reverse=True)

                orig_domain = urlparse(original_url).netloc

                    res.append({'url': url, 'score': score, 'highlights': highlights, 'full_content': full})

        return []

            if isa(node, HTMLText)
                push!(text_parts, node.text)
            elseif isa(node, HTMLElement)
                if lowercase(tag(node)) in ["script", "style"]
                    return
                end
                for child in children(node)
                    extract_text(child)
                end
            end
        end
        
        extract_text(body_elem)
        text = join(text_parts, " ")
        text = replace(text, r"\s+" => " ")
        return strip(text)
    catch
        return nothing
    end
end

function simple_encode(text::String, dimension::Int)
    words = split(lowercase(text))
    vec = zeros(Float32, dimension)
    for (i, word) in enumerate(words)
        hash_val = hash(word)
        for j in 1:dimension
            vec[j] += sin(Float32(hash_val * j))
        end
    end
    norm_val = norm(vec)
    if norm_val > 0
        vec ./= norm_val
    end
    return vec
end

function add_to_index(se::SearchEngine, url::String)
    text = crawl(url)
    if isnothing(text)
        return false
    end
    
    se.doc_store[url] = text
    chunks = chunk_text(text)
    chunk_embs = Matrix{Float32}(undef, se.dimension, 0)
    
    for chunk in chunks
        emb = simple_encode(chunk, se.dimension)
        chunk_embs = hcat(chunk_embs, emb)
        push!(se.metadata, Dict("url" => url, "chunk" => chunk))
    end
    
    if size(chunk_embs, 2) > 0
        se.vector_index = hcat(se.vector_index, chunk_embs)
    end
    
    doc = StringDocument(text)
    prepare!(doc, strip_punctuation | strip_case | strip_whitespace)
    push!(se.corpus, doc)
    se.dtm = DocumentTermMatrix(se.corpus)
    
    save_engine(se)
    return true
end

function save_engine(se::SearchEngine)
    serialize("faiss_index.jls", se.vector_index)
    serialize("metadata.jls", se.metadata)
    serialize("doc_store.jls", se.doc_store)
end

function search_neural(se::SearchEngine, query::String, k::Int, original_url::Union{String,Nothing})
    if length(se.metadata) == 0
        return []
    end
    
    qemb = simple_encode(query, se.dimension)
    search_k = min(k * 10, length(se.metadata))
    
    similarities = vec(qemb' * se.vector_index)
    indices = sortperm(similarities, rev=true)[1:min(search_k, length(similarities))]
    
    url_scores = Dict{String,Vector{Tuple{Float64,String}}}()
    for idx in indices
        if idx <= length(se.metadata)
            meta = se.metadata[idx]
            url_key = meta["url"]
            if !haskey(url_scores, url_key)
                url_scores[url_key] = []
            end
            push!(url_scores[url_key], (Float64(similarities[idx]), meta["chunk"]))
        end
    end
    
    results = []
    for (url_key, scs) in url_scores
        best_score = maximum(s[1] for s in scs)
        sorted_scs = sort(scs, by=x->x[1], rev=true)
        highlights = [s[2] for s in sorted_scs[1:min(3, length(sorted_scs))]]
        full = get(se.doc_store, url_key, "")
        push!(results, Dict("url" => url_key, "score" => best_score, "highlights" => highlights, "full_content" => full))
    end
    
    sort!(results, by=x->x["score"], rev=true)
    
    if !isnothing(original_url)
        orig_uri = URI(original_url)
        orig_domain = orig_uri.host
        for res in results
            res_uri = URI(res["url"])
            res_domain = res_uri.host
            if orig_domain == res_domain
                res["score"] *= 1.2
            end
        end
        sort!(results, by=x->x["score"], rev=true)
    end
    
    return results[1:min(k, length(results))]
end

function search_keyword(se::SearchEngine, query::String, k::Int)
    results = []
    query_words = Set(split(lowercase(query)))
    
    for (url_key, full) in se.doc_store
        score = 0.0
        full_lower = lowercase(full)
        for word in query_words
            score += count(word, full_lower)
        end
        
        if score > 0
            sentences = split(full, r"[.!?]+")
            highlights = String[]
            for s in sentences
                s_stripped = strip(s)
                if !isempty(s_stripped) && any(w -> occursin(w, lowercase(s_stripped)), query_words)
                    push!(highlights, s_stripped)
                    if length(highlights) >= 3
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            
            push!(results, Dict("url" => url_key, "score" => score, "highlights" => highlights, "full_content" => full))
        end
    end
    
    sort!(results, by=x->x["score"], rev=true)
    return results[1:min(k, length(results))]
end

function search_engine(se::SearchEngine, query::String, search_type::String="auto", k::Int=10)
    original_url = nothing
    query_text = query
    
    if startswith(query, "http")
        original_url = query
        qtext = crawl(query)
        if !isnothing(qtext)
            query_text = qtext
        end
        search_type = "neural"
    end
    
    if search_type == "auto"
        words = length(split(query_text))
        search_type = words > 4 ? "neural" : "keyword"
    end
    
    if search_type == "neural"
        return search_neural(se, query_text, k, original_url)
    elseif search_type == "keyword"
        return search_keyword(se, query_text, k)
    end
    
    return []
end

se = SearchEngine()

function handle_add(req::HTTP.Request)
    try
        body = JSON.parse(String(req.body))
        url = get(body, "url", nothing)
        
        if isnothing(url)
            return HTTP.Response(400, JSON.json(Dict("error" => "URL required")))
        end
        
        success = add_to_index(se, url)
        status = success ? "added" : "failed"
        return HTTP.Response(200, JSON.json(Dict("status" => status)))
    catch
        return HTTP.Response(400, JSON.json(Dict("error" => "Invalid request")))
    end
end

function handle_search(req::HTTP.Request)
    try
        query = ""
        k = 10
        search_type = "auto"
        
        if req.method == "POST"
            body = JSON.parse(String(req.body))
            query = get(body, "q", "")
            k = get(body, "k", 10)
            search_type = get(body, "type", "auto")
        else
            uri = URI(req.target)
            params = queryparams(uri)
            query = get(params, "q", "")
            k = parse(Int, get(params, "k", "10"))
            search_type = get(params, "type", "auto")
        end
        
        results = search_engine(se, query, search_type, k)
        return HTTP.Response(200, JSON.json(results))
    catch
        return HTTP.Response(400, JSON.json(Dict("error" => "Invalid request")))
    end
end

function handle_get_content(req::HTTP.Request)
    try
        uri = URI(req.target)
        params = queryparams(uri)
        url = get(params, "url", nothing)
        
        if isnothing(url)
            return HTTP.Response(400, JSON.json(Dict("error" => "URL required")))
        end
        
        content = get(se.doc_store, url, "")
        return HTTP.Response(200, JSON.json(Dict("content" => content)))
    catch
        return HTTP.Response(400, JSON.json(Dict("error" => "Invalid request")))
    end
end

router = HTTP.Router()
HTTP.register!(router, "POST", "/add", handle_add)
HTTP.register!(router, "GET", "/search", handle_search)
HTTP.register!(router, "POST", "/search", handle_search)
HTTP.register!(router, "GET", "/get_content", handle_get_content)

HTTP.serve(router, "0.0.0.0", 8080)
